adjudication.rationale: In `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve`, when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true it calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` inline (synchronously) before `fetch_http`, and there is no rescue around it. Any exception from `PollFeed#poll_feed` (e.g., `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` or `SimpleRSS.parse`) will bubble up and prevent `fetch_http` from running, so a broken/unreachable feed can block on-demand embedding for unrelated `@embed_url`s. Since `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` does not disable retries, Sidekiq retries would repeat this behavior each attempt.
